questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Rhea has noticed that when the small workshop where her mother works shut down, the shops in her neighbourhood, the bus timings and the way her family spends its evenings all changed as well. She asks her teacher why a single change can affect so many parts of life at once. Consider the following statements. 1. Social Science helps us understand how different aspects of life are interconnected. 2. Human beings live in societies and depend on each other in many ways. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.

evidence:

in our social world, but also why it happens and how different
aspects of life are interconnected.

Human beings live in societies and depend on each other in many
ways.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Aarav is deciding which optional subject to take up next year and wants to know what makes Social Science different from the subjects he already studies in school. Consider the following statements. 1. Social Science is the systematic study of human society. 2. In Grades 6 to 8 Social Science was explored through stories of people, places, and events. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Meera's cousin studies Physics, Chemistry and Biology and tells her that those subjects, and not Social Science, are the ones that study human society. She is not sure whether she should correct him. Consider the following statements. 1. Subjects like Physics, Chemistry and Biology study the natural world, and Social Science focuses on society, institutions, cultures, and human interactions. 2. Social Science only tells us what happened or where things are located, and does not explain why events occur. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: The assertion is true but the reason is false.
